experiments.title: Eliminate the high-half extension under a word shift

evidence.CLIF: ireduce.i16 high64; uextend.i32 high16; ishl.i32 high32,16; bor.i32 low32,shifted; store.i32

experiments.proof: An I32 left shift by16 discards all source bits above bit15. It can consume the existing I16 register without materializing its zero extension, including dirty high bits. Keep the low-half mask. General admission: fixed count modulo32 is nonzero and narrow_input_bits+count>=32. The original loop-carried packed marker is legitimately wide.
implementation_options: Teach shifted-register I32 AND/OR/XOR lowering to look through the narrow unsigned extension. Preserve flags-off images and all shared narrow/wide users.

A separate more ambitious pack rule could replace both masks plus OR with a32-bit BFI. The current backend lacks a BFI machine instruction; it would need explicit read/reuse-def operands, encoding and metadata support, plus actual JIT checks. Allocation may add a copy, so count and time final images.
experiments.native_tests: Dirty I64 host operands reduced toI8/I16; shifts around0/15/16/23/24/31/32/33/63/64; AND/OR/XOR with either commutative placement; shared original and extended results; variable-count and insufficient-shift fallbacks; guarded stores and untouched neighbors.
